sample: WITH instant AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT clock_timestamp() n) SELECT to_char(n AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS at_exact,to_char((n-interval '3 days') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS history_exact,to_char((n+($1::integer*interval '1 second')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS start_at,to_char((n+($1::integer*interval '1 second')+interval '1 hour') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS end_at FROM instant
column: SELECT format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,a.attnotnull AS not_null,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_value FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid='os_participations'::regclass AND a.attname='reminder_consent' AND NOT a.attisdropped
constraints: SELECT conname,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid IN ('os_participations'::regclass,'os_participation_outbox'::regclass) AND conname IN ('os_participations_reminder_consent_size','os_participation_reminder_marker','os_participation_outbox_delivery_bounds') ORDER BY conname
originalIndex: SELECT i.indisunique AS unique_index,i.indisvalid AS valid,pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid) AS predicate,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS definition FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid='os_participation_reminder_original'::regclass
rls: SELECT relname,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND relname IN ('os_participations','os_participation_outbox','os_previews') ORDER BY relname
noDdl: SELECT has_schema_privilege(current_user,current_schema(),'CREATE') AS schema_create,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolinherit,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member=r.oid) AS memberships FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user
exactPerson: SELECT to_jsonb(p) AS row,to_char(p.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_exact,to_char(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_exact,to_char(p.confirmed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS confirmed_exact FROM os_participations p WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2
outbox: SELECT to_jsonb(o) AS row,to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_exact,to_char(o.next_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_exact FROM os_participation_outbox o WHERE org_id=$1 ORDER BY id COLLATE "C"
previews: SELECT org_id,id,actor_id,kind,payload,checksum,base_revision,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_exact,to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS expires_exact,to_char(committed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS committed_exact,(expires_at-created_at=interval '10 minutes') AS window_valid FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND kind='participation-reminder-v1' ORDER BY id COLLATE "C"
audits: SELECT action,detail FROM os_events WHERE org_id=$1 AND action LIKE 'participation.reminder.%' ORDER BY id
counts: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participation_outbox WHERE org_id=$1 AND intent_kind='reminder') AS outbox,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND kind='participation-reminder-v1' AND committed_at IS NOT NULL) AS receipts,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_job_tenants WHERE org_id=$1) AS tenants,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_events WHERE org_id=$1 AND action='participation.reminder.scheduled') AS audits
expiryWitness: SELECT expires_at<clock_timestamp() AS expired,committed_at IS NOT NULL AS committed,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_exact,to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS expires_exact FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2
expireAccepted: UPDATE os_previews SET created_at=created_at-interval '1 day',expires_at=expires_at-interval '1 day',committed_at=committed_at-interval '1 day',payload=jsonb_set(payload,'{receipt,acceptedAtExact}',to_jsonb(to_char((committed_at-interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'))) WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND committed_at IS NOT NULL
duplicateOriginal: INSERT INTO os_participation_outbox(org_id,id,participation_id,event_revision,purpose,channel,state,payload,participation_revision,intent_kind,consent_revision,consent_copy,user_id,link_id,link_revision,recipient_hash,policy_epoch,template_version,relay_key,payload_hash,budget_bytes,next_at,created_at) SELECT org_id,$3,participation_id,event_revision+100,purpose,channel,state,payload,participation_revision+100,intent_kind,consent_revision,consent_copy,user_id,link_id,link_revision,recipient_hash,policy_epoch,template_version,$4,payload_hash,budget_bytes,next_at,created_at FROM os_participation_outbox WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2
faultFunction: CREATE FUNCTION os_reminder_test_fault() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE j jsonb; hit boolean; BEGIN j=to_jsonb(NEW); hit=current_setting('app.reminder_test_fault',true)=TG_ARGV[0] AND ((TG_ARGV[0]='outbox' AND j->>'participation_id'=TG_ARGV[1]) OR (TG_ARGV[0]='audit' AND j->>'action'='participation.reminder.scheduled') OR (TG_ARGV[0]='receipt' AND j->>'committed_at' IS NOT NULL)); IF hit THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fictional reminder rollback control' USING ERRCODE='P0001'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$
